$comment: Known-failure baseline (APRV-426). A ledger of debt, not a suppression list: nothing here changes an exit code, and a run whose every failure is on this list is still a red run. What the list buys is the sentence a closing note could not previously make honestly, 'these failures and no others'. Ids are written by scripts/ci-failure-ids.mjs as <suite>::<test name path>; the suite half is a run-tests.mjs --only name, so an entry can be rerun on its own. Compare a run with `node scripts/run-tests.mjs --baseline`, or an ids file with `node scripts/ci-baseline.mjs <ids-file>`. Every entry names the task that owns the fix; fixing a failure means deleting its entry in the same pull request. See docs/ci-verdict.md.
